leads.note: The version-independent slice ships: process.argv reaching the path of fs.writeFileSync, fs.appendFileSync or fs.openSync, directly or through path.join(base, segment), path.normalize(path) or path.resolve(base, segment). New public models: bifrost.node-path-javascript-declarations/-summaries 0.1.0; bifrost.node-fs-javascript-summaries 0.2.0 adds appendFileSync and openSync. The fixture run is proven_by_summary with 5 definite, complete findings. Other path.join arities stay inconclusive (bifrost-dev#9985), as does process.argv[i] passed inline (bifrost-dev#9986). The Windows device-name part needs runtime and platform evidence (bifrost-dev#9983).

The built-in verification part is version-gated. The version-independent slice needs a comparison-operator sink that joins an HMAC digest with request provenance; no such sink form is known (tracked broadly in the CodeQL JS/TS parity epic, bifrost-dev#4385). Not probed.

The version-independent slice ships: process.argv reaching legacy url.parse(urlString) or url.format(urlObject), which Node documents as unsafe for untrusted input on every release. New public models: bifrost.node-url-javascript-declarations/-summaries 0.1.0. The fixture run is proven_by_summary with 4 definite, complete findings; the WHATWG new URL near miss stays clean. Reading .hostname from the parsed result leaves the run inconclusive (no Url property model), with the finding kept. The url.format crash part needs runtime evidence (bifrost-dev#9983).
